$comment: Fact ledger: every phone number, dollar figure, deadline and program-status claim this skill makes, with the primary source it was checked against. scripts/check-facts.mjs fails CI when a fact is past its recheck date (verified_on + recheck_days, or the explicit recheck_on), when a listed file is missing, or when the value (or each string in match) no longer appears in its files. Recheck intervals: phone numbers 180 days; dollar figures and program status 90; annual-cycle figures use recheck_on with the next cycle's date. To update a fact, re-verify it on the source, set verified_on to that day and, if the wording changed, update value/match. Never add a fact you have not verified yourself, and never back-date verified_on. docs/ holds symlinks to these files, so list the source path only.
